attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "Disabling transitive pinning removes explicit version locks on transitive dependencies, so their versions can now float based on whatever direct dependencies request, potentially introducing unexpected/inconsistent package versions across the entire solution without any corresponding code review of those version changes."}
